page.title: SSH servers
page.description: Remote machines your agents sign in to and control. Passwords and keys stay in the vault — the AI never sees them.
page.emptyTitle: Let agents work on your servers
page.emptyDescription: Save a server once and a chat or agent can sign in, run commands, edit files and move them back and forth. Godmode signs in for them — the password or key never reaches the AI.

toast.hostKeyChanged: The server presented a different host key than the pinned one. If it was reinstalled, forget the host key (⋯ menu) and test again.
toast.hostKeyForgottenDescription: The next connection pins the key the server presents.
toast.deletedDescription: Its saved password and key were removed from the vault.
toast.assignedAgent: Every run of the agent can sign in to it.
toast.assignedChat: Runs in the chat can sign in to it.
toast.unassignedAgent: Chats that picked the server themselves keep it.
toast.unassignedChat: Runs in the chat can't sign in to it anymore, unless its agent has it.
toast.publicKeyCopiedDescription: Add it to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the server.

chip.tooltipNone: Let this chat sign in to your servers
chip.tooltipInherited: Can sign in to {{names}} — assigned to {{agent}}
chip.tooltipActive: This chat can sign in to {{names}}
chip.title: SSH servers
chip.description: Runs in this chat can sign in, run commands and move files. Godmode types the password or key.

card.testTooltipPinned: Sign in and check the host key
card.testTooltipPin: Sign in and pin the server's host key
card.pinnedHostKeyTooltip: Pinned host key — Godmode refuses the server if it presents another one.
card.singleChatHint: For a single chat, pick the server with the SSH button in its message box.
card.runsAs: Runs as <mono>{{user}}</mono> on <mono>{{host}}</mono> — stops after 2 minutes. Agents use the same connection.

stage.command: Signed in, but the first command failed

errors.name: Give the server a name
errors.host: Enter a host name or IP address
errors.hostOnly: Only the host — the user goes below
errors.username: Enter the user to sign in as
errors.publicKey: That's a public key — use the private key (the file without .pub)
errors.keyMissing: Paste, load or generate a private key

dialog.addedDescription: Pick it for a chat with the SSH button, or assign it to an agent.
dialog.fileTooBig: That file is too big for a private key
dialog.description: Godmode signs in for your agents. The password or key is sealed in the vault — the AI never sees it.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.hostHint: Paste user@host:port to fill in all three.
dialog.keyPlaceholder: Paste a private key (OpenSSH, PEM or PuTTY)
dialog.passphraseHintLocal: This key is protected — Godmode needs its passphrase to sign in.
dialog.passphraseHint: Only if the key is protected.
dialog.sudoHint: Godmode types it when an agent runs a command with sudo. An agent with a shell on this account could capture it — a narrow NOPASSWD sudo rule is safer.
dialog.sudoPlaceholder: Only if sudo asks for one
dialog.descriptionHint: Agents read this to know what the server is for and how to work on it.
dialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Production web server — Ubuntu, nginx and Postgres. Deploys go to /srv/app.
dialog.installGodmodeHint: Projects with a folder here run their chats on the server. Godmode installs itself in ~/.local/bin and keeps up with this computer.
dialog.shareLogins: Share logins with Godmode on this server
dialog.shareLoginsHint: Copies the vault there: website logins, 2FA codes, API keys and app secrets, so agents on the server can use them. Off: they stay on this computer, and switching it off removes them from the server again.

authorize.title: Add the public key to the server before testing
authorize.description: Sign in another way once (your hosting panel or console) and run this — then Godmode can use the key.

result.hostKeyChangedBody: That's expected after a reinstall. If nothing changed on the server, someone may be intercepting the connection — don't trust the new key.
result.trustsOnly: Godmode trusts only this host key from now on.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteDialog.bodyKeyAndSudo: Godmode forgets the server and deletes its saved key and sudo password from the vault.
deleteDialog.bodyKey: Godmode forgets the server and deletes its saved key from the vault.
deleteDialog.bodyPassword: Godmode forgets the server and deletes its saved password from the vault.
deleteDialog.oneUserFallback: The agent or chat using it loses access to it.
deleteDialog.manyUsers: The {{n}} agents and chats using it lose access to it.

godmode.hint: Install it so projects with a folder on this server can run their chats there.

godmode.updateFailed: Couldn't update Godmode on the server
godmode.removed: Godmode on {{name}} was stopped and removed
godmode.removeFailed: Couldn't remove Godmode from the server
